name: Mobile & Field Experience
summary: Adaptive, role-aware human-work experience across desktop, tablet, phone and future watches: BPMN tasks/process start, incident triage/alarms, field evidence, safe continuation and optional tablet authoring; one authoritative engine and API.
next_action: MFE1 software is merged (#1492, #1495, #1497, #1498, #1500); collect physical iOS/Android acceptance of the self-service start in MFE0 #1451 before closing MFE1. MFE1A (Console page for start grants, #1639) is active: PR A #1642 (blockers field) merged, PR B #1655 (page, read-only application hint, Playwright, docs) open; it stays active until an acceptance run against a real server with sign-in.

slices.title: Architecture and real-device baseline
slices.note: ADR-0514 Accepted; PRs #1448/#1449/#1452/#1453/#1454/#1458/#1460 merged with green CI. PR #1455 adds responsive two-column form-js Tasks/Start layouts with E2E; code is merged, but hardware acceptance remains pending. Physical iOS/Android, 200% zoom, accessible inputs, keyboard, foldable and complex-form evidence remain open in #1451.

slices.title: Mobile Tasks and Process Start
slices.note: MFE1 mobile Tasks/Start UI PRs #1468/#1469/#1470/#1472 are merged. ADR-0516 is accepted; PR #1486 merged the deny-by-default process-scoped grant evaluator and PR #1489 merged audited immutable grant/revoke revisions persisted atomically in the sidecar and recovered on restart. The admin-only start-grant management API (list/get/put/delete/history/preview, admin's own session, directory/application/newest-version checks, 409 revisions, fail-closed after a failed write) is merged (PR #1492); it enables no start by itself. GET /api/v1/me/startable-processes (own session, newest eligible version only, sorted and capped) is merged (PR #1495). POST /api/v1/me/processes/{key}/instances (grant and version re-checked as a guard in the command turn, server-side start-form constraints, reuse of the operator start path, startedBy and WAL-replay recovery test over the safety-inspection example) is merged (PR #1497). The Tasks Start view for task users (offered only with a grant, all outcome states including unknown outcome, 320/390/768px Playwright E2E) completes ADR-0516's slices (merged, PR #1498). The owner decided on 2026-11-02 that "published" means the newest deployed version within the application (no release-membership requirement); ADR-0516 records it. A bilingual handbook section for administrators and task users is in PR #1500. MFE1 stays active: the issue #1456 acceptance list still needs real iOS/Android evidence (MFE0 #1451). Existing operator rights are unchanged.

slices.title: Start-grant administration in the Console
slices.note: Planned 2026-11-09 by the owner (plan docs/planning/mfe1a-start-grant-administration.md). Console → Administration → Start grants page over the existing ADR-0516 admin routes: application, processes with audience by name and offered/not-offered state, grant/revoke by name with 409 handling, check a person or group, history. Plus a read-only, admin-only hint per process in the application's Deployments tab. Server change limited to an additive blockers field (with the newest definitionKey/version) on the list and single grant reads; no new route, no new authority, no new ADR. Two PRs: A server field, B web page, hint, Playwright and docs. Started by the owner on 2026-11-09: plan merged (#1640); PR A (blockers on the grant reads) #1642 merged; PR B (Console page, read-only application hint, Playwright, docs) is #1655. Stays active until an acceptance run against a real server with sign-in (owner decision 2026-11-09).

slices.title: Mobile incident triage
slices.note: Owner-approved limited parallel MFE2 UI slice on 2026-11-01 despite active MFE0/MFE1 (explicit three-slice WIP exception). PR #1477 delivered the contract and PR #1479 was merged with green CI for read-only operator mobile grouped incident triage and bounded details. No notification, acknowledgement, repair or new authorization; physical-device acceptance #1451 remains open.

slices.title: Incident alerting and escalation
slices.note: Design secure deduplicated durable-fact alerts, acknowledgement/ownership ADR, monitored escalation and fallback without a second notification engine.

slices.title: Field capture and evidence
slices.note: Camera, QR/barcode, staged evidence with validated durable references outside process variables and WAL.

slices.title: Offline drafts and synchronization
slices.note: Secure drafts, completion operation IDs, server-side dedup/status checks, conflict handling and restart/replay tests; no premature success display.

slices.title: Optional large-tablet BPMN authoring
slices.note: Reuse bpmn-js with adaptive inspection and touch/pen modelling only where real-device validation supports it.

slices.title: Wearable companion and cross-device handoff
slices.note: Proposed watchOS/Wear OS companion proof only after MFE1 authenticated task deep links and MFE3 durable alarm identity/delivery: privacy-safe minimal urgent signal and authenticated handoff to phone, no new task/incident command path. Secure draft continuity depends on MFE5. Watch delivery, authorization and any one-tap action require a separately accepted ADR and actual hardware tests; no watch functionality is shipped.
